# Operators, Sections & Underscore

Edva uses Pratt parsing to resolve operator precedence and associativity. This chapter specifies all operator tiers, comparison and range semantics, operator and field-accessor sections, and the scoping rules of the implicit placeholder `_` and cycle index `_i`.

## Precedence and binding power table

<!-- BEGIN operators.yaml -->
| Tier | LBP | RBP | Operators | Associativity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cycle | 10 | 20 | `@` `@@` `@>` `>--` `-->` `--^` | left |
| sequence | 20 | 30 | `;` | left |
| apply | 30 | 30 | `$` | right |
| feed | 40 | 50 | `$>` `$>>` `$+>` `$->` `.>` | left |
| choice | 50 | 60 | `|` `[pattern]` `!|` `|->` `|+>` `|-->` `|++>` | left |
| assignment | 60 | 50 | `=` `:=` `+=` `::=` | right |
| range | 70 | 80 | `..` | left |
| logical or | 80 | 90 | `||` | left |
| logical and | 90 | 100 | `&&` | left |
| bitwise or | 100 | 105 | `.|.` | left |
| bitwise xor | 105 | 110 | `.^.` | left |
| bitwise and | 110 | 120 | `.&.` | left |
| comparison | 120 | 130 | `<` `>` `==` `!=` `!<` `!>` | left, same-line |
| shift | 130 | 140 | `.<.` `.>.` | none |
| addition | 140 | 150 | `+` `-` | left |
| multiplication | 150 | 160 | `*` `/` `%` | left |
| unary prefix | 160 | 180 | `!` `+` `&` `++` `.!.` `~~` `?` `??` `-x` `#size` | right |
| postfix / apply | 170 | 180 | `call ()` `.` `::` `: cast` `{N}` `@[...]` `!!` `--!` | left |
| primary | 180 | 180 | `primary` | left |

<!-- END operators.yaml -->

| Parsing Rule | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Left-associative tiers (`RBP > LBP`) | Operator binds tightly on the left (`a - b - c` $\equiv$ `(a - b) - c`) |
| Right-associative tiers (`RBP <= LBP`) | Operator extends rightward (`f $ g $ x` $\equiv$ `f(g(x))`) |
| Choice absorption (`$` / `$>`) | `$` (LBP 30) and `$>` (LBP 40) sit below `choice` (LBP 50), absorbing unparenthesized RHS choices (`a $> b | c | d` $\equiv$ `a $> (b | c | d)`) |
| Operator sections (`op rhs`) | 13 binary operators with a leading operand omitted and mandatory trailing space form a 1-arg function over `_` with RBP 130 |

## Relational, equality, and chained comparisons

Comparisons sit at LBP 120, RBP 130 and return a bare flag `<>` (`<+>` or `<->`). Edva writes greater-or-equal as `!<` ("not less") and less-or-equal as `!>` ("not greater"); `<=` and `>=` are not comparison operators (`=>` is the function arrow).

| Operator | Meaning | Valid Operand Types | Floating-Point / Special Semantics |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<` | Less than | Numeric, `Rune`, `String`, `Addr` | Ordered (`OLT`); `<->` if either operand is `NaN`. Rejected on rams/enums (`E3127`) |
| `>` | Greater than | Numeric, `Rune`, `String`, `Addr` | Ordered (`OGT`); `<->` if either operand is `NaN`. Rejected on rams/enums (`E3127`) |
| `!<` | Greater than or equal ($\ge$) | Numeric, `Rune`, `String`, `Addr` | Ordered (`OGE`); `<->` if either operand is `NaN` (distinct from `!(a < b)`) |
| `!>` | Less than or equal ($\le$) | Numeric, `Rune`, `String`, `Addr` | Ordered (`OLE`); `<->` if either operand is `NaN` (distinct from `!(a > b)`) |
| `==` | Equal | Scalars, `String`, records, enums, `Type`, two bare Flags `<>` | Deep structural equality on records and enums; on two Flags, logical XNOR (`E3027` on other rams, `E3084` on fn payloads); zero-alloc segment check on `str == (p1, p2, ...)` |
| `!=` | Not equal | Scalars, `String`, records, enums, `Type`, two bare Flags `<>` | Logical negation of `==` (`UNE` on floats: `<+>` if either operand is `NaN`); on two Flags, logical XOR |

### Chained comparisons

Relational operators (`<`, `>`, `!<`, `!>`) on the **same source line** chain mathematically, evaluating interior operands at most once:

| Chained Expression | Equivalent Short-Circuit Lowering | Middle Operand Evaluation |
|---|---|---|
| `a < x < b` | `t = x; (a < t) && (t < b)` | Evaluated **at most once** |
| `a !> x < b` | `t = x; (a !> t) && (t < b)` | Evaluated **at most once** |
| `a !> x !> b` | `t = x; (a !> t) && (t !> b)` | Evaluated **at most once** |
| `b > f(x) > a` | `t = f(x); (b > t) && (t > a)` | `f(x)` called **at most once** |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

in_half_open: Int, Int, Int => <>
in_half_open = x, lo, hi => lo !> x < hi

io::out $ in_half_open(5, 0, 10)   // <+>
io::out $ in_half_open(10, 0, 10)  // <->
```

## Range operators (`..`, `...`, `..=`)

Range operators sit at LBP 70, RBP 80. Endpoints must be adjacent to the operator without whitespace (`E2025`). Ranges are consumed by choice guards `[...]`, cycles `@`, and slice/substring calls `x(...)`:

| Operator | Interval Kind | Math Notation | Lower Bound `a` | Upper Bound `b` | Choice Guard `[...]` | Cycle `@` | Slice / View `x(...)` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `a..b` | Half-open (left-closed, right-open) | $[a, b)$ | Closed ($a \le x$) | Open ($x < b$) | `a !> x < b` | `a` through `b - 1` | Elements `[a, b)` |
| `a...b` / `a..=b` | Closed (both inclusive) | $[a, b]$ | Closed ($a \le x$) | Closed ($x \le b$) | `a !> x !> b` | `a` through `b` | Elements `[a, b]` |
| `a..` | Lower-bounded closed | $[a, \infty)$ | Closed ($a \le x$) | Unbounded | `x !< a` | Unbounded from `a` | From `a` to `?x` (`-k..` from `?x - k`) |
| `..b` | Upper-bounded open | $(-\infty, b)$ | Unbounded | Open ($x < b$) | `x < b` | `0` through `b - 1` | Elements `[0, b)` |
| `...b` / `..=b` | Upper-bounded closed | $(-\infty, b]$ | Unbounded | Closed ($x \le b$) | `x !> b` | `0` through `b` | Elements `[0, b]` |
| `..` | Unbounded | $(-\infty, \infty)$ | Unbounded | Unbounded | `<+>` | Unbounded from `0` | Full view `[0, ?x)` |

## Arithmetic, bitwise, shift, logical, and map operators

| Category | Operators | Operand Types | Result Type & Semantics |
|---|---|---|---|
| Arithmetic | `+` `-` `*` `/` `%` | Numeric (`Int`, `Float`, `i8`..`u64`, `f32`, SIMD vectors) | Same numeric type (`+` also concatenates `String`, `Rune`, and `Builder`) |
| Bitwise | `.|.` `.^.` `.&.` `.!.` | Integerish (`Int`, `i8`..`u64`, integer SIMD vectors) | Same integer type (`.!.` is unary bitwise NOT) |
| Bit shift | `.<.` `.>.` | Integerish | Left shift (`.<.`) and right shift (`.>.`); sections infer `Int => Int` |
| Logical | `&&` `||` | `<>` (Flag) or compatible heap ramifications | Short-circuiting AND / OR |
| Map access | `m ^ k`<br>`m ^? k`<br>`m ^- k` | Map `K ^ V`, key `K` | `^`: `< V | Error >` lookup (`m ^ k = v` inserts)<br>`^?`: `<>` key existence check<br>`^-`: `<>` key removal |

## Operator sections and field-accessor sections

An **operator section** writes a 1-argument function `value => value op rhs` by omitting the left operand of a supported binary operator. A **field-accessor section** writes a 1-argument projection `r => r.field` using a leading dot inside parentheses.

### Section syntax and rules

| Section Form | Syntax | Desugaring | Rules & Diagnostics |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Additive section** | `(+ rhs)`, `(- rhs)` | `_ => _ + rhs`, `_ => _ - rhs` | Mandatory space after operator (`-3` is negative literal; `+b` is Builder freeze) |
| **Multiplicative section** | `(* rhs)`, `(/ rhs)`, `(% rhs)` | `_ => _ * rhs`, `_ => _ / rhs`, `_ => _ % rhs` | RHS binds with RBP 130 (`* 2 + 3` $\equiv$ `_ => _ * (2 + 3)`) |
| **Comparison section** | `(< rhs)`, `(> rhs)`, `(== rhs)` | `_ => _ < rhs`, `_ => _ > rhs`, `_ => _ == rhs` | Missing space (`>3`) emits `E2031`. `!=`, `!<`, `!>` do **not** form sections; use `(_ != rhs)` |
| **Shift section** | `(.<. rhs)`, `(.>. rhs)` | `_ => _ .<. rhs`, `_ => _ .>. rhs` | Automatically infers `Int => Int` when unannotated |
| **Bitwise section** | `(.&. rhs)`, `(.^. rhs)`, `(.|. rhs)` | `_ => _ .&. rhs`, etc. | Since bitwise LBP < 130, parenthesize bitwise RHS inside arithmetic sections (`+ (3 .&. 1)`) |
| **Excluded operators** | `||`, `&&`, `$`, `$>`, `$>>`, `!=`, `!<`, `!>` | — | Do not form sections; write `(_ != 0)` or `x => ...` |
| **Field-accessor section** | `(.field)`<br>`(.0)`<br>`(.outer.inner)` | `r => r.field`<br>`r => r.0`<br>`r => r.outer.inner` | Must be parenthesized (`(.)` or bare `.field` emits `E2064`). Uses a fresh internal parameter, so it never shadows an enclosing `_` |

```{.dva .run}
#use io
#use fp

#type User (name: String, age: Int)

double = * 2
shl1 = .<. 1
get_age: User => Int
get_age = (.age)

xs = Int{}
xs += 3
xs += 5
mapped = fp::map(double, xs)

io::out $ shl1(mapped(0)!!)                 // 12
io::out $ get_age(User("Alice", 30))        // 30
```

```{.dva expected-error="E2031"}
f = >3
```

```{.dva expected-error="E2064"}
x = (.)
```

### Section evaluation by syntactic context

| Context | Example | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| **Direct binding / call / pipeline** | `f = * 2; 5 $> (* 2) $> (+ 1)` | Evaluates RHS each time the section is called |
| **Choice predicate guard** | `x [< 0] "neg" [> 0] "pos" | "zero"` | Applies predicate section to scrutinee `x` |
| **Bare ram payload branch** | `opt | (+ 2) | 0` / `opt | (.name) | ""` | Applies section directly to the unwrapped slot payload |
| **Enum payload branch** | `box [Item] (+ 2) | 0` | Applies section directly to variant payload (`E3084` on payload-free variant) |
| **Ordinary value/predicate branch** | `mode [> 0] (* 2) | (+ 1)` | Returns the section **as a function value** (`Int => Int`) without applying to `mode` |
| **Ram bind (`$>>`)** | `opt $>> (x => <+ x + 1 +>)` | Continuation must return a ramification; `opt $>> (+ 1)` emits `E3091` |

```{.dva expected-error="E3091"}
#type Option < Int | >
some = Option(<+ 7 +>)
res = some $>> (+ 2)
```

## Implicit underscore (`_`) and cycle index (`_i`)

The exact identifier `_` has context-dependent implicit roles, governed by strict static scoping rules:

| Context | Syntax | Meaning of `_` / `_i` | Diagnostic on Misuse |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Grouped implicit lambda** | `(_ * 2)`, `(10 - _)`, `((a = _, b = 1))` | Innermost enclosing `(...)` group containing a free `_` becomes a 1-arg function (`_` repeated inside the same group refers to the same single parameter) | — |
| **Operator section** | `(* 2)`, `(* _)` | Implicit left operand (`* _` $\equiv$ `(_ * _)`) | `E2031` if space omitted |
| **Headless choice / guard** | `[< 0] -1 | 1`, `['a'...'z']` | Wraps choice/guard into a 1-arg function over `_` (outside statement `@` body) | `E3003` if omitted subject has no `_` |
| **Implicit cycle body** | `10..12 @ io::out(_ + _i)` | `_` is current element/byte/map-value; `_i` is `0`-based index (or map key `K` in `m @`). Saved/restored across nested cycles; does not survive cycle exit | `E3004`: reading `_` or `_i` after cycle exit |
| **Ram payload branch** | `r | _ + 1 | 0` | `_` is the selected slot's payload (`E4011` fatal abort if `_` extracts negative `Error` slot on failure) | `E3004`: `_` on unit/absence slot (`<Int|>` 2nd branch) |
| **Enum payload branch** | `e [Item] _ + 1 | 0` | `_` is the matched variant's payload | `E3004`: `_` on unit variant (`[Empty] _`) |
| **Ordinary guarded branch** | `x [> 0] x + 1 | 0` | Does **not** bind `_` in the branch body (preserves function-valued branches) | `E3004` on `7 [> 0] _ + 1 | 0` |
| **Structured pattern wildcard** | `p [(a = _, b = 20)] ...` | Matches component without binding a variable (`[Item _]` is rejected) | `E2109`: redundant `_` in `[Item _]` |
| **Explicit parameter** | `_ => expr` / `a, _ => expr` | **Forbidden** across all lambdas, functions, cycles, and `#!` params | `E2040`: explicit `_` parameter |
| **Assignment target** | `_ = expr` / `_ := expr` | **Forbidden** | `E2044`: cannot assign to `_` |
| **Unbound value reference** | `x = _` | **Forbidden** outside an active implicit binding scope | `E3004`: `Undefined: _` |

```{.dva .run}
#use io

square = (_ * _)
sub10 = (10 - _)
io::out $ square(4) + sub10(3)   // 23

#type Scores String ^ Int
m = Scores()
m ^ "alice" = 95
m @
   io::out $ (_i, _)                // ("alice", 95)
```

```{.dva expected-error="E2044"}
_ = 7
```

```{.dva expected-error="E2040"}
f = _ => 42
```

```{.dva expected-error="E3004"}
x: Int
x = _
```
